title: Dublin Port cold store
summary: A 400 A supply upgrade and six freezer-room submains, completed with the store at −25 °C.
brief: A second blast freezer pushed the existing supply past its design load. The store could not defrost, so the work had to happen in live conditions.
outcome: We installed a new 400 A supply, six monitored submains and a standby changeover, working in 90-minute windows between defrost cycles. The store stayed below −22 °C throughout.
